title: Well Matched: matching first-post candidates with European business school departments
description: A free, open-source, browser-based tool that reads a PhD candidate's materials the way a shortlisting committee might and shows how well they match European business school departments. It runs on the user's own Anthropic API key; nothing is sent to the developer.

creators.name: Salter, Ammon
creators.affiliation: Warwick Business School, University of Warwick
